events.title: English Localization and Subtitles Are Here!
events.summary: This demo update introduces:English translations for the interface, menus, and gameplay hints.Russian and English subtitles for audio logs, announcements, and story dialogue.The option to switch between Russian and English in the menu.A subtitle toggle that remembers your preference.Chinese localization is also in development. We’ll share more when it’s ready.If you notice a translation issue or a problem with subtitles, please let us know in the Steam discussions. Your feedback helps us improve

events.title: In Tenebris Demo is Now Available
events.summary: Unfortunately, English localization is not available in the current demo build yet. We are already working on it, and in the next few days we plan to release an update that will make the demo playable in English.This is a very important milestone for us. If you have already played the demo, please consider leaving a review on Steam or sharing your feedback in the discussions.
